title: [3.1.0.3] Dismissing Android Keyboard Closes Wizard Before Completion
body:
On my S22 Ultra, after filling out the bolus wizard, the Android keyboard (SwiftKey) sits over the OK button on the confirmation screen.

Dismissing the keyboard closes the wizard before you can hit OK.

Also happens on carb/insulin entry screens.

![Screenshot_20221214_085802_AndroidAPS](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/25760491/207432328-92764cb7-6610-40e6-99be-df2615083462.jpg)

comments.body: this is purely android thing. how could i help?

@MilosKozak you say like I'm supposed to know already it's an Android thing. It never used to do this. It seems like a bad UI bug. Maybe it's Android, sure. But I don't know that, so I reported it. Besides, whether Android or not there may be a way round it. Sounds like you're saying there isn't.

There are things you can do as an app developer to work around it. Maybe it's not a priority for you, which is fine. But it abruptly got worse for me. Maybe it's the S22 or maybe Android update. But it's been an issue for only a couple of months now. I guess if I reported it others could also add thier experience at the very least.
@old-square-eyes probably we can change focus on OK click.

Just tried with Samsung keyboard and it does the same.
